Wide armchairs surround the table, their plush seats covered in matching fabric.  Paintings of native arctic animals line the walls, their canvasses framed in gilt edged white wood.
title: [Icemule Hall, Ice Room]
26819.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long wooden bar stretches the entire length of the far wall, and above it hangs a small painting.  A row of wool-covered barstools, crafted in various heights, sit before the polished counter.  Small tables and chairs cover the planked floor, each dimly lit by a single candle.  Off to one corner, a group of drunken halflings argue loudly over a game of cards.
title: [Icemule Hall, The Glacier]
26820.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of bookshelves enclose this cozy hideaway, gleaming in the light of the brass torch sconces that are affixed to the walls.  Plush chairs sit off in one corner while cushions lie scattered about the floor, offering comfort to those wishing to thumb through the many tomes.  An arched bay window frames a plush padded window seat on the far wall, providing a bird's eye view of the snowy environs below.
title: [Icemule Hall, Loft]
26821.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of basket-covered shelves line the walls of this efficient kitchen.  A wide stone sink sits in an island counter of pristine marble, providing the means to prepare a variety of foods.  Shiny brass hooks hang above the center island, boasting a variety of cooking vessels and utensils.  Standing next to the door is a wooden rack, stacked high with polished serving dishes.
title: [Icemule Hall, Pantry]
26822.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide glass counter dominates this small shop, taking up most of the space in the room.  Shelves line each of the plain wood-paneled walls, holding storage bins of yellow, blue, red, and green.  Brass lanterns flicker brightly, casting shadows on the many wares.
title: [Icemule Hall, Supply Emporium]
26823.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long glass display case follows the length of one side of the hallway, various artifacts of importance to Icemule resting safely inside.  A crystal candelabra sits on the other side, lighting the way down this long corridor.  At the end of the hall rest two doors, one green, the other white.
title: [Icemule Hall, West Hallway]
26824.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Plush feather mats sit in a large circle on a planked wooden floor.  A polished writing desk is pushed up against the far wall, sheaves of paper and fresh plumes waiting for use.  A vase filled with colorful wildflowers sits by the doorway, the blooms releasing a sweet fragrance into the room.
title: [Icemule Hall, Wildflower Room]
26825.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long padded bench occupies the floor, resting on a brightly woven rug that is spread from wall to wall.  A smaller bench sits on a raised platform at the head of the room, a colorful beaded tapestry hanging behind it.
title: [Icemule Hall, Rainbow Room]
26826.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The chamber appears to be circular.  However, a stand of life-sized stone trees obscures the walls, rendering that determination uncertain.  Forming an ageless glade, the carven boles of the trees are lifelike, down to detailed bark and leaves.  Icicles drip from the rock leaves, and in the center of the frozen grove stands an altar.
title: [Huntress Chapel]
26827.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Enclosed by a tall wrought iron fence covered in frost, this small circular space is peaceful and quiet.  Bright winter roses in dozens of different hues are scattered around the perimeter of the circle, the plants crawling up the fence and surrounding the space in winding green vines and splashes of vibrant color.  A long modwir bench is placed in the center of the cobblestone circle, facing the entrance to the shrine.
title: [Winter Rose Garden]
26858.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This sturdy wooden stand has been spruced up after several years of neglect.  Braided woolen throw rugs dot the well-swept floors, and a fresh coat of bright blue paint covers the walls.  The room itself is cluttered with a wide variety of tables, display cases, and other containers each bursting with odds and ends for sale.  A few light drafts of bitingly cold air enter through some holes spaced randomly about the floorboards.
title: [Wiggim's Charms]
26920.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Town citizens mill about the open space of the tent, weaving in between the support poles and engaging in idle chatter.  A few individuals cluster near a large announcement board, gossiping loudly.  The distinct smell of freshly baked tarts wafts from a snowflake-carved modwir refreshment cart in one corner of the room.  Near the rear of the tent, an icicle-engraved fel box stocked with tinder rests next to an iron brazier.  The atmosphere lends a potential respite from the cold just outside.
title: [Citizens' Tent, Reception]
27031.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick, ornate rugs depicting a colorful history of Icemule Trace layer the floors of the softly lit room.  A masterfully crafted spherical metal stove commands attention in the center of the area surrounded by some plush velvet pillows.  A woven manroot stalk bench sits opposite the curtain leading back to the reception.  An occasional shadow from the stove dances across the tent walls.
title: [Citizens' Tent, Meeting Area]
27032.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In this comparatively smaller room of the tent, several large containers with neatly printed labels line one tent wall.  A modwir bin labeled "Warm Stuffses" with partitions for numerous articles of clothing sits beside a scuffed balenite footlocker labeled "Fighting Stuffses" large enough to hold several weapons and pieces of armor.  Winterberry-stained handprints cover the outside of an off-white wicker basket labeled "Belly Stuffses," likely a space reserved for tarts and other snacks.
title: [Citizens' Tent, Donations]
27033.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The scent of pine is strong here, but works in concert with the decor of this efficient store.  A dusting of snow covers every flat surface, falling off the edges in a frozen tableau.  Wide green shelves line the walls, festooned with nooks and crannies of every imaginable shape and size.  Despite the amount of storage, not a single space is unoccupied.  Halfling attendants scurry about, assisting customers as needed, but remaining busy with any number of small tasks.
title: [Irreplaceable Items on Ice]
27351.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small cross-hatched window looks out to the wilds beyond the gate, and a few torn, bloodied bandages hang along a series of nails hammered into its lower edge -- simple tokens testifying to the bravery of the local guard.  A long, winding staircase edges the round walls of the barbican tower, the shallow steps defended by an iron-barred gate.
title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
27702.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shafts of faint light pierce the darkness of the tower from windows farther up the stairs, while torches illuminate the gloomy interior.  Soft echoes reverberate in the cramped space, from the faint chittering of rodents to the occasional gust of wind.
title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
27703.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The brisk winds of the north flow through the numerous windows that line the circular, stone walls.  Tattered bits of leather and cloth sit beneath the narrow slits, the stains on them a telltale sign of the many battles fought from these heights.  A particularly wide window opens up to the east, and a length of thick rope is tied to a grommet at its base.
title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
27704.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense barbican stands sentry over the wide South Gate of Icemule Trace, and the eastern tower stands high over this portion of the wall.  A small window provides the only means of entry, but it is far too high to access without some help from above.  To the north, the wall looks over Barter Alley to Tartifact's Bakery and the other shops of Trader's Way.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27705.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick forests dominated by pine and spruce obscure the southern approaches to the city.  To the north, the wall looms over Barter Alley, which attracts a very respectable clientele among the halfling citizens of Icemule Trace.  The prevailing winds blow perpendicular to the South Wall, causing a tremendous buildup of frosty muck in the southern corner of the wall.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27706.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wide stone walls provide very little protection against the winds that blow night and day from the surrounding mountain heights against the city walls.  The stamping of militia guards' feet has compacted the snow beneath your feet, making this stretch of wall particularly perilous.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27707.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This corner of the wall looks over the corner where Barter Alley meets Trade, and a steady stream of patrons visit the shops clustered around the entrance to the southeastern corner tower.  Beyond stands the grassy field of Giantman Path, which is dominated by an ancient oak tree almost as tall as the walls themselves.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27708.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small piles of pale white snow collect in the corners of the tower's doorway, the pale grey stone glistening with faint moisture.  A spiral of stairs slowly ascends the height of the barbican, and distant shafts of light pierce the gloom further upwards.  An iron-barred gate guards the base of the winding stairway, the metal bars encased in a thin shell of glistening ice.
title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
27709.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairway continues to spiral around the circular walls of the barbican, the dark grey stone incised with a trailing pattern along the shallow steps.  The sound of howling wind echoes along the tower, its chilly presence sending bits of dust and snowflakes tumbling through the air.
title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
27710.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The shallow steps of the winding stairway taper off at a round room marked by a group of narrow slitted windows.  Pale starlight shines through the narrow gaps in the stone, shimmering wanly against the bits of ice formed along their edges.  A steel grommet fixed beneath one of the wider windows holds a long length of rope.
title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
27711.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wide South Wall looks down over the well-traveled confined of Bootlegger's Alley, which skirts between the wall and several of the most-patronized businesses in the city.  Across the alley to the north lie the grounds of House White Haven, while the view to the south is dominated by impenetrable forest.  Immediately to the east is the western barbican tower of the city's South Gate, which offers access only via an impossibly high window.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27712.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Night and day, working-class halflings stream into the Honeybeer Inn, which stands across Bootlegger's Alley from this section of the wall.  Entering gaunt, tired, and hungry, they leave looking well-fed, rested, and restored to good spirits.  It was perhaps a feeling of envy for these patrons that led a lonely guard to carve a bees' hive and beer mug into the icy northern wall.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27713.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The frosty arctic wind rushes through the forest to the south, filling the region with the noisy clash of air on needle and leaf.  An occasional birdcall or animal growl rises above this cacophony.  What was simple mystery now represents the threat of the unknown.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27714.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The blades of the windmill turn in time with the gusting of the winds above this corner of the wall.  Immediately below the wall, the sometimes unsavory patrons of Bootlegger's Alley make their way quietly among the frost-encrusted cobblestones and other less innocent perils of the narrow thoroughfare.
title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
27715.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A single steel shield hangs over the entryway, its edges trimmed with stained leather and its surface heavily scarred.  A winding staircase slowly ascends the length of the tower, an iron-barred gate set at the threshold to ensure that those who enter are well-protected.  A few hardy patches of weed have grown in the cracks along the floor, enjoying shelter from the cold outside in this safe haven.
title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
27716.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The deep blackness of the tower's interior is permeated only by the occasional soft ray of starlight from the outside, or the mellow orange and yellow tones of sparsely-placed torches.  A few rustling tapestries line the walls, their cloth far too faded and torn away to reveal any distinct imagery.  The shallow stairs continue to wrap around the circular walls in a spiraling fashion.
title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
27717.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A circle of windows looks out onto the surrounding landscape from the top of the tower, each offering as its view only a thin slice of the world as its view because of the arched, slit-like construction.  A few stick-like markings mar the otherwise smooth stone surface beneath the windows -- the arcane figures likely the handiwork of some rather bored guardsman.  A long, thick rope has been tied to a grommet beneath the widest of the windows, permitting access to the eastern wall below.
title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
27718.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wall to the south is dominated by the barbican over the East Gate of the city.  A tall barbican tower stands just south of this position, and a single window high above provides the only point of access from the wall.  The curious odor of medicinal tart-baking wafts from Ma Leaftoe's shop on the other side of Fear Alley.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27719.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stone walls looking down past Hope Alley to Stumbleskink's cleric shop have been patiently carved with a wide variety of symbols invoking the attention of the Arkati and other immortals.  In the mountains to the east, the walls of the abandoned abbey glow in the moonlight.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27720.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Immediately beneath the wall to the west is the narrow pathway known as Hope Alley.  Most of the customers move from shop to shop with their faces lit with good cheer, but some few move to the north with speed, purpose, and wary glances.  To the east, the landscape is split between night-black forests and moonlit snowfields.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27721.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The view to the northeast is dominated by the snow-capped mountains in the distance.  To the west, the neighborhood of Temple Burrow battles against the ice that flows from the glacier, across the north wall, and into the streets of Icemule Trace.

The view to the northeast reveals the darkened figures of mountains in the distance, their massive forms outlined in negative relief against the starlit sky.  To the west, the homes of Temple Burrow burn lights to keep the darkness at bay.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27722.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tower's interior is protected from both the elements and attack by a massive ironwood door further reinforced with dark steel.  A long, winding stairway spirals up the edge of the circular walls, ascending towards the very top of the barbican.  An iron-barred gate stands before the very first step, its bars glistening with a faint coat of ice.  A few simple glass vases rest at the foot of the gates, each filled to the brim with a collection of dried flower petals.
title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
27723.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sawdust is scattered as an aid to traction, as militia guards and other visitors track melting snow and ice across the shallow steps leading from the lower rooms to the upper defenses of the barbican.  Shadows constantly shift in the faint torchlight, retreating with each momentary flare of the flames, then surging forward as the light wanes back into gloomy darkness.
title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
27724.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A variety of thick wooden planks provides a sturdy footing at the top of the staircase, the walls opening up into a variety of narrow slitted windows.  Various scuffs, nicks and scorches mar the otherwise smooth stone walls, a telltale sign of the many battles fought here.  A larger window harbors a long piece of rope tied to a grommet, the majority of its length arranged in long serpentine coils.
title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
27725.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wall ends in a tall barbican tower to the north, keeping watch over the East Gate of Icemule Trace.  A few adventurers wander through the gate at all times of day and night, some eager to test themselves against the wilds and some bearing the wounds and treasure that mark the relative success of their ventures.  To the west across the narrow Trade Alley stands the city jail.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27726.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: At night, this section of wall is dominated more by smells than sights.  From the west comes the smell of broiling meats and baking tarts, while from the east wafts the acrid smell of pine needles and decay.  Immediately below the wall, Trade Alley teems less-than-savory customers.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27727.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A strident voice calling patrons to the rat races in the Bazaar rises up to the walls at every hour of the day.  The narrow lane between city wall and warehouses known as Trade Alley sees occasional foot traffic from adventurers and citizens alike.  To the east stands a thick forest that could be hiding any manner of threat to the peace of the city.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27728.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The view to the west reveals the businesses of Dwarven Circle, while the east is dominated by snow-covered pine trees.  To the south stands one of the sturdy corner towers, its fluttering flags proclaiming Icemule's defiance of weather and foes alike.
title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
27729.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A few scattered alum pebbles lie in a heap in the corner, their unusual roundness and shine hinting at their use to pass the guards' slow nights away.  Shallow steps whose surfaces are marred by many muddy bootprints ascend toward the top of the tower, the entrance guarded by an iron-barred gate.
title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
27730.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The small steps continue their winding pathway both up to the very top of the tower and all the way to the very bottom, the fairly nondescript walls punctuated by a crackling torch here and there.  A few shattered bolts and torn fletchings litter the otherwise smooth steps.
title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
27731.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A few simple tokens hang above each narrow slitted window, each marred by some faint scar, dent, or tear.  Dark planks harboring black stains in the wood make up the floor, their short railings ensuring that none will take a rather nasty plunge to the floor far below.  A length of knotted rope is gathered beneath a grommet set into the wall beneath one of the wider windows to allow access to the west wall.
title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
27732.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Off in the distance lie the high Ice Plains behind their sturdy rolaren gate.  In the opposite direction stands the impressive structure of Silverwood Manor.  The wall itself is empty except for the ubiquitous snow and ice, which seems determined to claim the structure as its own.

Both sides of the wall are similarly cloaked in darkness.  On the city side, the nearest visible lights come from Silverwood Manor on Cursed Street, almost in the center of town.  The winds howl down the near empty walls, filling the night with a mournful chill.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27733.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the east, Magical Burrow lies under a dense blanket of fog.  The narrow confines of Incantation Alley immediately beneath the wall are visible, as is the upper story of an abandoned manor house on Wraith Road.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27734.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The western wall looks out over wide open fields of snow and ice.  The pale moonlight bathes the fields in silver, highlighting the walls and trenches which appear as flat black in the darkened landscape.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27735.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wall ends at the northwest corner of town, where a sturdy tower projects an image of strength and security to the citizens of Icemule Trace.  The view of Magical Burrow is completely obscured by a thick fog that fills the walls like soup lapping at the rim of a bowl.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27736.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A simple wicker wreath hangs above the entryway, the thin twigs making up its body tied tightly with bits of twine and leather.  A pale white staircase slowly ascends in a spiraling fashion toward the top of the tower, the stone chipped and marred by stains in some places.  An iron-barred gate stands before the steps, ensuring a secure point to check those who would venture further.
title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
27737.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bits of straw and other debris provide a slightly sturdy footing upon the shallow, smooth steps.  Wavering amber torchlight plays along the walls in lurid waves of crimson and orange, illuminating the rather nondescript passageway that leads further up towards the top of the tower.
title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
27738.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs come to an end in this upper room, where a rough construction of planks and reinforced wood forms a small platform giving access to slitted windows in the walls.  A stunted little barrel stands between the gaps of the numerous slitted windows that encircle the area.  One wider window looks down upon the western wall of Icemule Trace, and a knotted rope is tied to a grommet securely fastened to its stony ledge.
title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
27739.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wall comes to an end at the tall barbican tower rising over the West Gate of the city.  A window provides the only access to the tower, and that only from the most difficult height.  To the west can be seen the Warrior's Guild compound and the Nightowl Pub, while immediately beneath the wall a variety of unsavory types make their way down the narrow thoroughfare known as Brewer's Alley.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27740.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the east, Pilsner Avenue parallels the wall on the opposite side of Brewer's Alley.  A portion of the old city wall runs along this avenue, and the citizens use it as a memorial to lost loves.  In the distance lies the healer's cottage on Malt Road.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27741.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Immediately beneath the wall to the east runs the narrow confines of Brewer's Alley, and a number of carters and brewer's apprentices run its cobbles night and day.  A few citizens and adventurers wander out of its shops at all hours as well, seeking bargains or the odd rare artifact.  In the distance, Barley Lane runs east toward an abandoned well.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27742.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The windmill towers over the city walls at the southwestern corner of town, and the gentle creaking of the mechanism competes with the whistling of the wind through the great western forest to fill the air with a constant din.  Off to the east stand the arms and armory shops, from which a great smoke and noise rises night and day.
title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
27743.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The glacial floe above this section of wall has been painstakingly carved over time into a sculpture of notable beauty. From the depths comes a horde of trolls, charging over a wide open field toward a small village.  An armed band of halflings stands in martial array ready to protect kith and kin from the invaders.
title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
27745.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The view to the east is blocked by the sturdy height of the corner tower, which is distinguished only by a window high above the wall.  Atop the tower, flags fly to signify the militia's occupation of the structure.  To the south, the streets of Temple Burrow twist and turn around the great temple, which stands like a beacon of hope and fear to the faithful of every denomination.
title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
27746.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep channels have been carved into the ice wall to the north, as meltoff ran down from the top of the glacier only to freeze on contact with the city walls.  If there is stone beneath your feet, thick blue ice hides it completely.
title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
27747.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This section of wall looks out over the Sorcerer Guild compound, and your night vision is threatened by the fiery smoke rising from a chimney-topped tower in its center.  To the north is nothing but icy darkness.
title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
27748.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wide enough for halfling militiamen to stand five or six deep, these walls are so thickly encrusted with ice that only the most dexterous can keep their footing.  Along the northern battlement, some wag has carved a poem to help pass a lonely watch.
title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
27749.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: At their northwest corner, the city walls are thick with ice.  A high tower rises to the west, its pennant flags declaring the city's proud defiance of its enemies, including the incessant frigid winds.  To the south is the rundown quadrant known as Magical Burrow, while the view to the north is completely dominated by the glacier.
title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
27750.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed by windows of frosted glass, the front door of the post office allows wintry air to cut through the warmth of the close room.  Beeswax candles sit along the window sills, but they lend more light than heat and perfume the air gently with their honeyed smell.  The real heat source is a blazing coal stove behind the polished pine counter.
title: [Northern Post, Mail Room]
30186.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shelves full of packing materials line the brick walls of the little shop, making it seem more cramped than its limited space would suggest. Crystal-globed candles occupy sconces on the walls, lending a pleasant beeswax scent to the air and brightening the surroundings.
title: [Northern Post, Little Shop]
30187.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The spacious work chamber is lit by a number of candles in festive colors, each encompassed by a faceted crystal globe. Bright tapestries soften the cold stone of the walls, featuring artistic cavalry scenes and forested splendor.
title: [Hailscatter Atelier, Workroom]
31426.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Climbing out of the shop below, the airy steel of a spiraling staircase rises to the second story of the structure. Standing guard before an arched double door of darkly stained Ossian pine is an ice crystal statue painstakingly carved to resemble a wide-bodied dog frozen in a vigilant posture.

description: Cool light lazes down through clouded panels of bluish crystal set into the high ceiling of the antechamber.  The source of the radiance is obscured, but it dances and ripples like sunlight warped by the surface of a windblown pond.  Near to the door sits an umbrella stand stand worked of modwir and heavy bronze and a wall-anchored ice crystal chime.  Underfoot, a carpet runner depicts puckish frostlings engaged in a riot of mischievous activities from trickery to theft.
31428.location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Shivergale, Antechamber]

assignment.title: [Shivergale, Antechamber]

31428.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed by cloudy panels of bluish crystal, a wide fireplace dominates the rough-hewn western wall.  The scent of oiled leather rises from a singularly expansive couch positioned to benefit from the fire's heat.  Before it sits a low, wide refreshment table atop a snowy white warg pelt that contrasts brightly with the stone-tile floor below.  A northern archway proceeds into a cozy pantry, while a lacquered hoarbeam door breaks the carved granite of the eastern wall.
31429.location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Shivergale, Common Room]

31429.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed by walls lined with shelves bearing a plenitude of spices and sundries, the welcoming pantry is gently lit by frosted glass windows.  At the center, a spacious granite island boasts a spread of delectables and beverages spaced around an ice sculpture carved to resemble a thriving wolf pack.  Just inside the spruce archway, a shallow porcelain wash basin rimmed in hand-painted winterberries stands at the ready.
31430.location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Shivergale, Pantry]

31430.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tremendous four-poster bed with a lush teal comforter occupies the bedchamber, positioned beneath an illuminated crystalline dome etched with flurries of snowflakes.  Nearby, a frosted glass door opens onto a second-story patio that looks out over the rooftops and burrows of the town.  Silver threads glint from a tapestry of glacial blues and greens hanging on the opposing wall beside a lacquered hoarbeam door.
31431.location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Shivergale, Bedchamber]

description: Wrought iron fencing mounted with flower boxes of hardy snowdrops and vibrant purple crocuses encloses a spacious patio outside a frosted glass door leading into the home.  Sunlight awakens strange colors in the glacier encroaching from the north and the carved walls of ice holding the small town's burrows within their embrace.  Smoke trickles from the chimneys of several dozen buildings in an effort to hold the indefatigable cold at bay.
31432.location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Shivergale, Balcony]

31432.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of the room are covered in wool cut-outs of fuzzy penguins, flippers held high as they appear to descend down their parchment slide.  The workshop is situated with a glowing brazier, providing warmth to the room, alongside the thick peppered pelts lining the floor.  Across from the brazier is an ora-banded barrel set next to some work tables, the working area complete with a long tool rack hung above for easy access.  Wood paneling frames the doorway, accenting the overall design of the room.
title: [Penguin Workshop]
31441.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of the room are covered in a collection of parchment-winged butterflies, the insects dyed in various shades of lavender and mint.  The workshop is situated with a glowing brazier, providing warmth to the room, alongside the thick snowy pelts lining the floor.  Across from the brazier is an ora-banded barrel set next to a sturdy oak worktable, the working area complete with tool rack hung above for easy access.  Wood paneling frames the doorway, accenting the overall design of the room.
title: [Butterfly Workshop]
31442.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Raw hoarbeam timbers, glinting with cold veins of glacial blue and shining silver, line the lower half of the shop's dark stone walls.  They curve to frame a wide stone hearth, within which a roaring fire crackles invitingly.  Opposite the hearth, a burled pine countertop with scrimshawed ivory inlay separates a cozy nook from the rest of the shop.  Shelves line the walls behind the counter, holding various staples in neat glass jars.
title: [Kishnar's Hearth, Shop]
32867.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: White dryad hedges grow along the high iron fence enclosing the courtyard, which is paved with cobblestones.  Flying a silk pennant emblazoned with a charging mule, a low-roofed stone guard post stands toward the rear of the courtyard.  A lone training dummy of sackcloth, propped up by a spruce stake, stands near to the entrance.  It looks like it has endured more than a few beatings.
title: [Stout Street Armory, Courtyard]
33227.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A charging mule seal is picked out in mosaic tiles on the floor of the armory, worn by time and the passage of many feet.  A short, blocky desk of carved modwir guards the area before a riveted heavy steel door, kept meticulously free of dust and debris.  Lanterns suspended from the ceiling are unlit, but the smell of lamp oil lends a sweetly tart fragrance to the air.
title: [Stout Street Armory, Foyer]
33228.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ornate hoarbeam desk and accompanying leather chair sit in the corner of the spacious chamber, flanked by a stack of heavy wooden crates to one side.  Much of the room is given over to a large model of Icemule Trace occupying a tiered depression in the chamber's floor.  Despite the plain stone structure of the surrounding armory, no expense appears to have been spared in the construction of the wooden models or the bright-colored map on which they rest.
title: [Stout Street Armory, Map Room]
33229.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An old mural adorns the far wall of the close infirmary, lending a splash of color to the dour surroundings.  The floor and walls are made of stone and only a single barred window allows in sunlight in wan beams alive with scarce motes of sparkling dust.  Acrid and herbal, a medicinal smell emanates from a large mirrored cabinet in the northern wall.  Cots line the floor, clean and ready for triage.
title: [Stout Street Armory, Infirmary]
33230.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Racks of good steel weapons march in neat, orderly rows down the walls of the arsenal.  Many, but not all, appear sized for smaller wielders.  The air is close and heavily scented with acrid grease and polish used to keep the stored weaponry ready for combat.
title: [Stout Street Armory, Arsenal]
33231.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stately houses with old stone facades line the street as it ends in a small cobblestone court.  Their sprawling estates are dotted with pine trees, and in one yard, a garden full of colorful flowers thrives near the banks of a steaming hot spring.  One manse at the northernmost edge of the circle has gates of pale holly inlaid with walnut, a path of flagstones beyond shaded by old pine trees festooned with bright garlands.
title: [Commerce Burrow, Pioneer Court]
34066.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The shadow of the town's wall looms over the end of the way, casting the dreary collection of homes and storefronts into darkness.  Street lamps etched with reliefs of strange figures burn brightly, colluding with the sunlight to cast back the shadow, but they are hampered in their efforts by the cold fog that chokes the cobbled road.  Most of the houses along the way are large and old, heavy curtains drawn to preserve the privacy of their owners.
title: [Magical Burrow, Illusionist Way]
34068.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glossy blue slate, lacquered to resemble ice, stretches across the floor of the shop, reflecting the ambient light of the corner-built fireplace and giving the space a warm, soft glow.  Grey stone walls decorated with heavy tapestries support the exposed beam ceiling, while a long wooden counter faces the entry and is draped with various pelts, hides, and fabrics for customers to peruse.  A standing tapestry loom and a birch curing rack occupy spaces on opposite sides of the fireplace.
title: [Hint of Krint]
34070.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Partially enclosed by pale stone walls glinting with fingers of frost, the garden is shielded from much of the adjacent town center's din.  Bright winter roses in a splendor of frigid hues scale the walls in profusion, their thorny stems green despite a tracery of silvery rime.  At the center of the close stands a blue and white pavilion, its mule-printed pennants languidly waving in the breeze.  Near to the entrance, modwir bench sits by the entrance of a recessed shrine.
title: [Icemule Trace, Winter Garden]
34071.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved from pale marble that blushes faintly blue in the light of ensconced torches, the walls and arching roof of the shrine are carved with a multitude of winter roses.  The etched flowers are subtly tinted with various shades of red.  Beneath a teardrop-shaped arch of fine filigreed silver, a pale maiden statue stands with her hands raised, looking down at the kneeling forms of several statuary halflings.
title: [Winter Rose Garden, Shrine]
34072.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Banners of blue and white frame a mule-printed tent flap marking the entrance to the spacious pavilion.  Supported by a central pillar of hoarbeam that is heavily carved with penguins, polar bears, and wolves, the enclosed space is heated and perfumed by a number of pierced censers hanging from the support beams by chains of iron.  The eastern quadrant of the pavilion is dominated by a raised pine stage festooned with blue and white banners with a weathered spruce podium at the front.
title: [Icemule Trace, Meeting Pavilion]
34073.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several chairs upholstered in shades of blue and stitched with prancing penguins sit toward the western end of the pavilion in an intimate circle.  Behind them, a blizzard granite brazier cradles a small but merry fire that warms the surroundings and makes the chairs' shadows dance.  A wolf fur rug is laid out in the center of the circle.
title: [Icemule Trace, Meeting Pavilion]
34074.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Blue and white banners embroidered with rampant mules in cool colors hang over a sumptuous array of dishes and drinks crowding the top of a wide hoarbeam table.  An ice sculpture at the table's center depicts adventurers banding together against an immense winged manticore.  Several chairs are positioned near the buffet, upholstered in pale blue wool and patterned with tiny snowflakes.
title: [Icemule Trace, Meeting Pavilion]
34075.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The canvas walls of this small pavilion are hung with carefully tied bundles of hair in a variety of colors.  A vat of lye sits next to the pinned-back tent flap, but even that extra ventilation isn't enough to keep the harsh vapors from stinging your eyes.  Casually stacked on a low counter are bowls of henna paste, vinegar, sodden ashes, and dark ink.
title: [New Look, Hair Coloration]
34076.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An old chair with a wobbly leg takes up most of the space under this crooked awning.  A string has been tied from the side of the tent to a post stuck in the ground, and dangling from it are dull-looking shears and carving knives.  Drifts of shorn hair cover the ground, forming hummocks and valleys of blond and brunette.
title: [New Look, Haircuts]
34077.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In this shaded walkway between the three tents is a round iron table supporting a jar of brushes and a few pots of dye.  A cedar box full of bone hairpins and narrow strips of leather has been left right on the ground, in danger of being kicked over by a clumsy foot.
title: [New Look, Hair Adornment]
34078.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Here in the back corner of the pavilion a makeshift station has been set up to wash, dirty, curl, straighten, braid, loosen, and otherwise fuss with all kinds of hair.  Jumbled together in a crate are bottles of olive oil, combs, ribbons and pins.  Wood-handled irons are propped over a small fire pit, and the smoke has started to fill the enclosed space.
title: [New Look, Hairdressing]
34079.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wooden screens divide this large tent into smaller spaces, but they don't block the howls of agony coming from every corner.  A raised pallet partially obscured by a thin gauze curtain rests conveniently near a set of freestanding shelves.  Stored haphazardly therein are cyclamen roots, a bowl of birch sap, some sheep dung, a bottle of lemon juice, and a tub of quicklime.
title: [New Look, Skin Care]
34080.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Here inside the tent, the light wicker frame that provides support is just visible between the wool blankets used to help muffle sound.  A massive apparatus bearing a strong resemblance to a stretching rack is dwarfed only by a device whose purpose seems to involve a great deal of crushing and compacting.  Stuck into the ground is a tall pole marked off at intervals with red paint.
title: [New Look, Short and Tall]
34081.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rivulets of blood trickling down the legs of a crude operating table give some indication of the unpleasantness of this procedure.  Thick glass jars are stacked three deep, each one packed full of preserved eyes with their optic nerves still attached.  A very sharp-looking scalpel has been left at the foot of the table, ready for further use.
title: [New Look, Eye Colors]
34082.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lancets, needles, razors, and scalpels have been laid out in tidy arrays atop a narrow chest of drawers.  A solid oak chair fitted with many leather straps is pushed up against the flimsy wooden screen.  The sole nod to cleanliness appears to be a bowl of wine used to soak the instruments between uses.
title: [New Look, Eye Enhancements]
34083.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This small corner has been festively decorated with sketches of noses, illustrating a wide variety of shapes and sizes.  The cheeriness is broken, however, by the display of instruments used to achieve these many effects.  A chest full of neatly-rolled bandages and a basket of brown eggs sit at the ready.
title: [New Look, Nasal Sculpting]
34084.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The strange emptiness of this portion of the tent gives it an even more ominous feel.  The only object is an upright wooden box just large enough to contain one person.  Its narrow door latches solidly on the outside.
title: [New Look, Distinctive Marks]
34085.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A series of shaped wooden frames with adjustable metal screws have been fixed at head height in front of a row of straight-backed chairs.  They all face the near wall of the tent, where inspirational phrases have been painted in bright, cheery colors.  A few of the protruding screws still show traces of former users.
title: [New Look, Facial Repair]
34086.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thick-cut pine log palisade surrounds the courtyard, meeting at a large open gate.  A hitching post sits near the entrance of the enclosure, flanked by fresh hay bales and a water trough.  A large hand-carved black marble bowl rests on a polished steel pedestal in the center of the courtyard, a ring of birdseed hulls littering the snow beneath the bowl.  Off to one side, a small round table sits in a relatively protected area.  Unlit torches line a snow-edged pathway from the entrance to a rose-carved ironwood entryway with a pair of sturdy double doors.
title: [ICICLE, Courtyard]
34388.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Some faintly glowing lanterns reflect off the polished curved mahogany walls, creating a warm glow that illuminates the dark room.  A wooden sign with "Ice Hound Pub" burnt into the wood hangs above a blackened stone fireplace.  Cushioned booths with small tables line the curved walls of the pub.  A large polished cherrywood bar sits in the middle of the room.  Glass shelves behind the bar hold familiar and exotic alcoholic offerings.  Several doors lead in and out of the pub.
title: [ICICLE, Ice Hound Pub]
34389.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A white oak arch with swinging doors separates the kitchen and pub, sealing off some of the noise from the bustling staff at work.  A large fel cupboard occupies one corner, its doors ajar, revealing shelves stacked with sumptuous dishes and prepared desserts.  A white marble counter is laden with cutting boards and a variety of knives and utensils, while several pots and pans continuously bubble and bake across the numerous stoves built along the walls.
title: [ICICLE, Kitchen]
34390.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pond is nestled in the center of a ring-shaped building, a sturdy pine door leading back inside.  Sunlight reflects and refracts across the thick layer of ice that covers most of the pond's surface, causing a dazzling diamond effect.  A multitude of razor-thin grooves mar the surface of the ice, and the pond is surrounded by heaping snowdrifts, nearly concealing a worn grey beechwood log and an empty winterberry ale barrel that rests nearby.  A cleared path leads to a small fishing dock on the southern side of the pond.
title: [ICICLE, Frozen Pond]
34391.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A path cleared in the snowdrifts leads to and from a weathered pine dock that extends out over the southern side of the frozen pond.  Its surface is slick from a thin layer of ice formed by the morning's frozen dew.  A hole, big enough to fit a halfling, has been cut through the ice at the end of the dock, affording a glimpse into the murky depths of the pond.  Curious fish, seeking the warmth of the sun's light, cause the water in the hole to ripple.  A stone firepit sits near the opposite end of the dock.
title: [ICICLE, Fishing Dock]
34392.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Benches line the curved walls of this large, open area, all facing the center where an octagonal wooden stage serves as the focal point for onlookers.  Dangling from the ceiling directly above the stage is a magnificent chandelier.  A stone statue of a penguin stands at each of the four cardinal directions of the arena, serving as silent observers.  Strategically placed furthest away from both an opening with a pair of slatted saloon doors and a large pine door on the opposite end is a refreshments table.
title: [ICICLE, Rival's Ring]
34393.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cigar smoke hangs heavily and perpetually in the air of the gaming room.  A sign hangs above each of the entrances, a fir door and a pine door, reading, "Silverback Jack's."  Various tables are scattered around the area holding an assortment of cards, dice, and other gambling accoutrements.  Displayed prominently on one of the slightly curved walls is a dart board, hundreds of tiny, dart-sized holes peppering the wall around it.  A single dart has permanently wedged itself in a brass refreshments cart situated nearby.
title: [ICICLE, Silverback Jack's]
34394.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: From the modwir hardwood floors to the canvas-covered walls, the expansive room is a pet's wonderland filled with carpet-covered perches and towers to promote climbing and exploration.  A pet-friendly chaos of glittery balls and toys litter the floor, inviting inquisitive pet guests to play.  Plush silk pillows rest against the curved walls, a relaxation spot for pets and people alike.  Opposite a thick fir door, a tall cherrywood cabinet sits near a varnished mahogany door, a tiny pile of chewed rawhide next to it.
title: [ICICLE, Pet Parlor]
34395.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small white marble dais occupies the center of the modest theatre.  Plush velvet-covered cushions rest on the rows of benches that hug the curved walls, creating an intimate setting between audience and speaker.  An intricate, diamond-cut crystal chandelier is suspended over the dais, casting prismatic rainbows across the white marble.  A small faewood sideboard sits near a varnished mahogany door, a pumpkin-hued ash door opposite it.
title: [ICICLE, Laethe Theatre]
34396.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A warm glow illuminates the white ash walls from the crystal sconces placed around the office, and the scent of pumpkin pie permeates the room.  Two comfortable chairs flank a small marble table in front of a large oak desk in the center of the room.  Bay windows line the curved walls, allowing sunlight to filter in.  A carpet-covered perch sits near one window, a small wooden cage by another.  The cage door is unlocked and opened, a tiny note left in its escaped occupant's place.  A pumpkin-hued ash door leads out.
title: [ICICLE, Dirvy's Office]
34397.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Old pines tower to either side of the flagstone walk beyond a pale holly gate, the trees sheltering banks of driven snow beneath their verdant boughs.  Garlands festoon the branches of the evergreens, woven together from beautiful flowers foreign to such an unforgiving clime.  A manse with a gabled roof rules over the expansive estate, and welcoming candlelight flickers in its mullioned windows.  The front doors are of burled pine and are carved with prancing mules in relief.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Evergreen Walk]
34804.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A crystal chandelier hangs over the foyer of the manse, casting shards of light over a silver seal set into the pale marble floor.  The leaping mule etched into the metal is repeated in relief on the front doors, which are framed with windows that look out onto a snowy walk.  Opposite the entry, a grand staircase with banisters twined in fir garlands sweeps up to the second story.  Hallways branch to the west and east, proceeding beneath trefoil arches accented with ornately carved maplewood.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Foyer]
34805.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dark pine staircase spirals up toward the upper story of the manse, its banisters twined with fir garlands that perfume the air.  A long runner patterned with prancing mules in blue and white proceeds down the main hall of the manse's upper story, which branches off into lesser hallways leading to family and servant quarters.  The bordering railing offers a view of a spectacular chandelier fashioned in the shapes of hundreds of icicles, glittering and glowing with the light of dozens of votive candles.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
34806.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flames roar and pine wood gives a merry crackle from within a stone-framed hearth yawning out of the northern wall.  Comfortable couches of supple stouthorn rolton leather are positioned to take fullest advantage of the proffered heat.  A marqueted credenza positioned between two pairs of mullioned windows overlooking the yard profers holds bottles of spirits offer warmth of a different variety.  Smells of roasting meat and baking tarts waft gently from a trefoil arch in the eastern wall.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Parlor]
34807.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mullioned windows with cerulean velvet curtains allow moonlight into the chamber, the centerpiece of which is a rough-hewn table of honey oak ringed by chairs.  The opposing wall is given over to a long aspen bookshelf holding countless tomes, its glass doors criss-crossed by wrought iron bars brushed with silver.  Patterns of gold leaf frame the coffered ceiling, highlighting a painting of battle in the streets of a port town.  A trefoil arch opens onto a parlor, while a smaller pine door leads to the kitchens.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Dining Room]
34808.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The kitchen's windows are open to allow the cold air in, leavening the heat washing from brick ovens along the walls.  One holds a great boar roasting on a spit, while another heats a cauldron of spicy stew, and a third is occupied by racks of baking tarts.  On a spruce trestle table, more pastries are laid out in various stages of assembly.  Bowls of spices, from salt to paprika, occupy marble countertops along the walls.  Nearly concealed by some hogsheads of mead, a trapdoor descends into the cellar.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Kitchen]
34809.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Racks along the rough stone walls hold great barrels of wine, ale, and mead, leaving space in the center of spacious cellar for sacks of barley, hanging carcasses that have been salted to preserve them, and stacked wheels of stoutfoot blue cheese.  Despite the efforts of a lone torch ensconced on the northern wall, the cellar is bitterly cold.  Frost glints from the walls and ceiling.  A short ladder allows egress through a riveted pine trapdoor above.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Cellar]
34810.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glass-paned double doors on the eastern wall look out the silhouetted apple trees of an orched dotted with drifts of snow.  High windows frame the chamber, allowing moonlight to stream in from a variety of angles.  It spills gently over snowflake-patterned grey divan that are draped with knit fraelhan blankets in a variety of autumnal hues.  A thick fringed rug patterned with colorful leaves softens the marble floor.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Sunroom]
34811.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Some glass-paned double doors along the side of the manse open out of a cozy sunroom lined with tall glass windows.  Neat rows of fruit trees frame a path leading away from the doors through a small orchard, mostly consisting of wintercrisp apples, but with a few hardy varieties of plum and cherry mixed in.  The air is crisp and clean and the walls of the estate muffle most of the noise from the abounding town.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Orchard]
34812.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A nook at the end of the hallway is home to a verdigris bronze statuette that depicts a ragged halfling man leaping at a heavily muscled krolvin, dagger flashing.  Several beeswax candles burn in bronze holders around it, brightening the dark corner.  A runner patterned with prancing mules in blue and white adorns the cedar planks of the floor, gliding toward a knotted pine door.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
34813.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Family portraits, some badly damaged by the elements and age but nonetheless lovingly framed, hang over the stretch of hallway.  Doors leading off to guest suites come in a variety of woods, and each is incised with the stylized silhouettes of local fauna, from wolves to penguins.  Sweet beeswax candles in sconces along the walls light the way in the absence of windows.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
34814.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The upper hallway comes to an end near a pair of black walnut double doors, which are framed in an elaborate arch featuring inlaid chunks of holly, oak, and alder that from a gently undulating pattern.  Beeswax candles ensconced to either side illuminate the rich grain of the wood.  Before the entrance, an ancient Mhoragian rug depicts a cavalry charge.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
34815.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: On a lazy rise at the northwestern edge of the estate, a steel-framed glass greenhouse stands amid the rows of snow-dusted fruit trees.  Outside stands a wheelbarrow full of fresh soil and several sacks of compost.  The orchard proceeds almost up to the wall of the state, over which the slate-tiled roof of Clovertooth Hall can be seen.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Orchard]
34816.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm air of the greenhouse is sweetened by perfume from exotic plants blossoming throughout the large enclosure.  Smaller flower pots hang in tiered displays from the ceiling, while larger ones form sinuous aisles on the stone floor.  Most of the flowers growing are not native to the region, the bright petals of dragonstalks and honeysuckles suggesting origins rooted in warmer climes.  A wrought iron bench offers a place to rest and observe the verdant beauty.
title: [Dabbings Manor, Greenhouse]
34817.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Each length of the room is coated in pale colors, ranging from yellow to green to blue and lavender.  Along the walls are wood-framed illustrations, each clearly painted by children.  Off the eastern wall, a wide stairway ascends to the second floor.

description: Stretching the width of the building, and painted in cool blue and green hues, the room is organized with several rows of neatly made bunk-beds. A few chairs are scattered about, and a tall bookcase with a small selection of history books stands before the balustrade separating the stairway from the room.  A brightly painted door leads to a large washroom.
title: [The Wellington Home, Dormitory]
21682.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls are a soft russet hue and decorated with canvas tapestries depicting colorful fields and forests. 21683.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Brightly lit and painted in warm cream tones, the tidy room is filled with desks, all orderly arranged in groups. 21684.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The spacious hall is festively painted in bright colors, its high ceilings ringed with luminous flickering lanterns.  Vibrant paper streamers drape from the walls and some cheerfully decorated tables border an expansive polished walnut dance floor.

21685.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Long bench-style tables stretch across the entire length of the room, each with stacks of plates and cutlery organized on each end in preparation of mealtime.  A slatted swinging door swishes as a number of older children in aprons move about assisting the cooks.
title: [The Wellington Home, Mess Hall]
21686.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Low modwir shelves fill the room alongside some tables with straight-backed chairs.  Lit candles illuminate a series of well-used books along the shelves.  In the center of the room is a raised platform, where a wooden pedestal stands unattended.
title: [The Wellington Home, Study Room]
21687.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stone walls wrap around to form a solid enclosure to the courtyard, the ground smooth and paved with dark cobblestones.  Barely visible beyond the thick iron gate stretches North Ring Road and an expanse of the palisades of Wehnimer's Landing.  A large two-story brick building dominates the far end of the courtyard, its roof topped with a black and grey flag.
title: [Town Barracks, Inner Courtyard]
21688.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The floor of the main entry is of dark flagstone, deeply polished, the walls are of white marble, veined with crimson.  The walls are hung with brightly colored tapestries and filigreed oil lamps are set in bronze sconces to illuminate them.  Standing in even ranks along the walls are many types of armor from half a hundred eras and regions, each seeming to wait patiently for the trumpets of battle to sound, as they ever have and ever will.
meta: mapname:Wehnimer's Landing - House Of The Rising Phoenix
title: [House Phoenix, Entry]
21741.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Within this serene courtyard, a variety of young trees and flowering bushes thrive along the flagstone path leading from the archway to the main building.  A small grove of cherry trees provides a shady retreat near some polished wooden benches placed along a grassy bank leading down to a small bubbling spring.  Nestled within the shade of the fruit trees sits a small cherrywood beehive.  A polished cherry dart board inlaid with a rising phoenix hangs from a willow tree.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Courtyard]
21742.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This quiet, leafy bower seems remote from the courtyard below.  The gentle swaying of the tree in the breeze and the susurration of the leaves is relaxing.  Peering down through the willow branches you can spy the natural pool below.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Willow Tree]
21743.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The small spring is lined with a brilliant array of colorful stones.  Exotic plants, carefully arranged to provide privacy, grow in profusion along the bank.  A tall willow tree leans gracefully over the spring, as if granting its blessing on the swimmers.  The bottom of the spring is lined with fine sand, oddly warm to the feet.  Air bubbles rush up from below, tickling the bare parts of your skin.  A small waterfall trickles musically down a jumble of rocks, and a small wooden fishing dock juts out from a sandy bank.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Natural Springs]
21744.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The natural springs surrounding this dock start off shallow, but quickly turn deep at its very center.  All around the edges of this small dock are spots to stick a fishing pole, and a weatherbeaten driftwood bench rests at the far end, closest to the deepest part of the spring.  Protected from the elements, a small fire burns, remnants of previous fish fries evident all around it.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Fishing Dock]
21745.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fine mist eddies about your ankles as you enter this quiet niche.  Well-tended herbs and flowers grow in abundance around a pure-white marbled bench, tickling the senses with the scent of hyssop, rosemary, mint and jasmine.  The sound of trickling water draws your eyes to a small grotto cut into a wall of gray rock glistening with moisture.  The grotto shelters a statuette perched upon an ivory altar covered with a pristine sheen of water that drips from an over-hanging rock.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Hyssopp's Niche]
21746.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The elegant Grand Hall appears to have hosted many a merry celebration.  Candlelight from faceted ruby and crystal chandeliers casts a warm glow over a grand cherry banquet table and matching gilded chairs.  Mirror-clad arched alcoves on one wall hold small tables for private gatherings.  Marble pilasters with gilded capitals depicting rising phoenixes frame elaborately figured silk tapestries flanking the great white marble fireplace on the eastern wall.  At the west end of the room rests a small bar.
title: [House Phoenix, Grand Hall]
21747.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Here in the kitchens, a large oven warms the room and fills it with the scent of baking bread.  An ancient iron cauldron bubbles over an open fire, as rich steam billows forth to carry the aroma of rolton stew into the air as well.  The walls of the room are filled with shelves and cupboards stacked high with dried and preserved foods of all sorts.  Piles of fresh vegetables and slabs of finely marbled meats wait for the deft hand of the chef to prepare them.
title: [House Phoenix, Kitchens]
21748.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The library of the House is a largish room, with walls completely hidden by bookcases.  A wide selection of reading material can be seen from a cursory glance.  Treatises on science and history stand next to ancient volumes on forest lore and magic.  One rather extensive section seems devoted to arms and armor and the many subjects dealing with the arts of war.  Locked glass-fronted cabinets hold rare tomes and fragile scrolls and even the odd clay tablet.  Scattered around the room are several chairs.
title: [House Phoenix, Library]
21749.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A series of paintings hung along the walls here celebrate the founding officers of the House.  Two doors, one painted red, the other gold, lead to guest bedrooms.  To the south is a brightly painted door and eastwards, a solid oak door bars entrance to the Planning Room.
title: [House Phoenix, Second Floor]
21750.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ornate circular table, surrounded by large, upholstered chairs dominates the planning room.  Hanging from the ceiling is a well-polished crystal chandelier. title: [House Phoenix, Planning Room]
21751.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

21754.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

21769.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

21771.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Phoenix Annex, Marble Hallway]
21772.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

Though the room's scope and beauty is inspiring, the center of attention is a brilliant sapphire altar at the far end of the temple.  Heavy polished maple benches, trimmed in ivory, sit in ordered rows before the altar.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Quiet Temple]
21773.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Your footsteps are muffled by a long embroidered rug lining this hallway.  A green crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, holding several flickering candles.

21774.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of this guest room are painted a cheery yellow and there is a light scent of cinnamon in the air. A low bed with an elegantly engraved headboard lies against one wall next to a small wooden shelf.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Guest Room]
21775.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This expansive chamber is roughly triangular, and features richly carved rosewood panelled walls which depict scenes of the Gods of Light. A fireplace flanked by two armchairs fills another corner, while a round malachite-topped cherrywood table surrounded by comfy red pillows stands before a huge shelf filled with books.
title: [Phoenix, Krisenfest's Room]
21776.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This spacious room is warmed by sunlight streaming in through a window facing east. The oak floor is covered by a luxurious snow-white puma fur rug that almost looks as inviting as the bed.  In one corner stands a small bookcase filled neatly with several leather-bound books with esoteric titles.  Occasionally, you hear a faint sound coming from underneath the bed.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Catrissa's Room]
21777.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hardwood floor is brightly polished and a thick white tapestry adorns one wall.  A flowering vine grows in a ceramic urn next to the wall, lending a pleasant aroma to the air.
title: [Phoenix Annex, South Hall]
21778.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A faint trace of residual magic tingles your fingertips as you cross the threshold of this workshop.  A domed window in the ceiling lets in bright sunlight that shines directly upon a well-worn and slightly charred desk strewn with various parchments and notes.  The walls are lined with shelves and cabinets which contain beakers, flasks, and decanters of multi-colored liquids that sparkle in the light.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Workshop]
21779.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The brightly polished oak floor reflects the light from a pair of simple silver sconces attached to the wall.  A sweet soprano voice quietly singing an old folk song flows from an archway set in the northern wall.
title: [House Phoenix, Donation Room]
21780.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One wall of this small, well-lit hallway is decorated with a pair of magnificent paintings.  The other is almost completely covered with a grand tapestry depicting a battle scene.  In the flickering torchlight the figures on the tapestry seem to come to life.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Temple Hallway]
21781.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This tranquil room has been consecrated and dedicated to prayer, contemplation and reflection.  Four rows of pews with kneelers give the room a sense of order and discipline.  Inscriptions, inlaid with silver, grace three of the walls.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Sanctuary]
21782.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wisps of green, yellow and orange smoke drift lazily about the pavilion, all eventually rising to seep through a small opening in the top of the tent.  Two grey canvas walls are nearly concealed by thick wooden shelves, each one sporting a variety of colorful bottles and smoking vials.  In a corner of the tent sits a twitchy-eyed halfling alchemist, coughing and wheezing as he mixes the contents of glowing beakers.
title: [Consumption Junction]
21903.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Floral patterns in rose and cream velvet frame the windows of this delightfully private chamber.  Enclosed with a canopy and curtains of sheer lace, a large bed rests opposite a fireplace which burns with a cheerful light.  In front of the fireplace, there is a soft fur rug.  A delicately carved oak sideboard stands alongside the gold door.
title: [Silvergate, Bridal Suite]
22014.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm humid air of this tropical retreat invites you to cast away your worries and cares.  Flowering vines creep up the carved posts of a four-poster bed which provides support for a canopy of rustling ferns.  Water trickles from a fountain, cunningly crafted to resemble a waterfall, and fills a small bathing pool near the fireplace.  Several colorful cushions are scattered on the floor near the hearth.
title: [Silvergate, Jungle Room]
22027.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm soothing water relaxes your muscles and the scents of rose and cedar intermingle in the air, leaving you with a renewed spirit.  How refreshing!  Fresh water constantly trickles in from the mouth of a small marble fish statue.
title: [Jungle Room, Bathing Pool]
22028.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fresh as a country meadow, this cozy room welcomes you.  Pale green linens cover a brass bed, their color echoed in simple cotton curtains patterned with meadow flowers.  Painted carvings of herbs decorate the cream colored walls.  An armoire, crafted of rare varin stands in one corner, complementing the antique nightstands at bedside.  Opposite the bed, two cushioned chairs flank a brick fireplace.  A pot of fresh herbs, simmering over a small fire, fills the air with a fresh scent.
title: [Silvergate, Country Retreat]
22029.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas
