description: Nearly spilling over their knee-high granite borders, beds of colorful flowers of myriad varieties line a cobblestone pathway leading to a pair of rustic ironwood doors, the entrance to a large, granite-faced lodge.  The lodge's upper floors of massive, rough-hewn oak logs sport small balconies backed by large sheets of glass.  Hedges of laurel and boxwood march across the building's front. description: Highly polished wood floors are covered with woven wool rugs, providing splashes of color in the large, chandelier-lit foyer.  A burled maple doorway resides in the eastern wall, and a sweeping grand staircase leads to the second floor.  In the opposite corner, a dimly lit hallway leads to the interior of the lodge.  Several burnished leather sofas and chairs, facing a low stone hearth, invite rest, while a a wide gold-chased table is placed between them.  Beside the entry doors a small golden depository sits against the darkly paneled wall.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Common Room]
20734.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Completely paneled in polished pine planking, the walls hold elaborate antler sconces.  Several doors lead off to the east, and the nearest one rests ajar, revealing shelves of linens and cleaning supplies.  A carved pine door leads to a dimly lit room, while a faint glow emanates from a curved mottled green doorway.  The granite floor is polished to a gleam, its mica flecks sparkling as the candles gutter and flare.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Hallway]
20735.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gold-trimmed, dark green walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved mottled green doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling green and gold portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Intricate foliage has been etched into the metal, the vines intertwining to form a complex lattice pattern.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Transport Room]
20736.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lit by a single candle that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dim and wreathed in a thin veil of smoke that obscures the darkened corners.  A plush burgundy rug covers the hardwood floor and muffles the sounds of footfalls.  Scattered atop the rug are a few grey velvet settees, each one paired with a carved mahogany end table.  On one side of the room, a carved pine door leads out into the hallway, while opposite, a polished satinwood archway offers entry to the bar.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Game Room]
20737.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Walls of cherry-stained satinwood surround deep leather chairs with claw-footed tables alongside.  The eastern wall is completely taken over by shelves of liquor, from the common to the exotic, arranged in neat rows behind a long wooden bar, while tall carved-legged stools offer a place to sit at the bar.  A stuffed brown otter stands on a pedestal in one corner, its fur a bit tattered where numerous hands have rubbed its belly.  An ivory chandelier illuminates the area, and a red satinwood archway leads to a dimly lit room.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Barroom]
20738.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dark red satinwood paneling covers the bottom half of the walls, while the top half is painted a pale cream hue.  Sconces of polished brass hang on the wall, and a hammered tin ceiling displays an elaborate scene of hunters cornering their quarry.  A long runner of animal hides pieced into a repeated compass rose pattern ends at each of the three doors opening off of the area, while the staircase is left bare for its craftsmanship to shine.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Landing]
20739.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Barely decorated, this small office is encapsulated by ivory and pale blue striped walls, and is utterly cramped with furniture.  An expansive oak desk that looks to have barely fit through the door, its matching oak chair, and a tall bookcase have been placed so as to allow the best use of the space.  One wall is dominated by a square calendar marked with barely legible notations.  The opposite wall sports a glass-paned door, which serves as the only exit.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Office]
20740.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This spacious room is dominated by several oak-framed divans covered in quilted sepia suede.  Two overstuffed chairs flank a heavy, brass-studded side table under a panoramic curtained window.  The pale yellow walls are painted in a pattern of ochre-colored geckos climbing towards the ceiling, interrupted to the south by a wide oak door.  One delicate gold chandelier hangs from the intersection of two beams of oak underneath exposed rafters.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Gecko Room]
20741.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vivid lace coverlets gird the muted furniture in the room, adding a touch of color to the room.  Airy, cream-hued curtains have been tied back from some windows with rose-tufted sashes.  A plush couch holds a pale green hue, and a blown-glass vase of wildflowers sits on a low table next to one of the polished knotty pine walls.  A brass-inset door leads back out to the landing.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Sitting Room]
20742.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Leather-bound books neatly stacked on built-in shelves line the walls of this room.  Close to the window sits a scrivener's desk and tall chair, while a few small reading tables are fronted with leather chairs.  To one side, a dessert table holds a tray of drinks.  Two opposite walls of shelves are interrupted by a burled maple doorway and a set of double doors carved with fanciful figures from Elanthian history.  A dimly lit hallway leads deeper into the building.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Library]
20743.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Opening onto a vista of gardens and forest, floor-to-ceiling windows expand the space of the dining area.  A long maoral sideboard against one wall boasts refreshments.  Snowy white linens and fine porcelain adorn rosewood tables, some out in the open, while others are more private, behind square wooden columns holding the enormous exposed beams of the rafters.  Stuffed hawk-owls and eagles peer down from their perches in those rafters, while a woven runner carpets the hallway from the restaurant into the library.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Restaurant]
20744.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Providing both a rustic and elegant backdrop to a stately lodge, tall birches grow along a large expanse of finely-trimmed, emerald green lawn bordered by a thick pine forest.  To the east, the trees are more sparse, the ocean just barely visible through them.  A long, rectangular reflecting pool stands in the center of the lawn, bordered by two thin strips of brightly hued flower beds.  Resting on the lip of the pool is a small earthenware bowl that holds a handful of birdseed.
title: [Zephyr Hall, Back Lawn]
20745.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bustling kitchen staff work in organized harmony, rotating about cooking stations dedicated to everything from roasting whole animals to piping the frosting on desserts. description: Stretched out before you is a dimly lit modwir table topped with smooth green felt, a magnificent black drake adorning its surface. Behind the table stands an elegantly garbed dealer, his eyes blind and vacant.  His expression remains cold while his stick flashes out to scoop up the cubes.

description: Fine-grained dark wood spans the length of the brig's deck, highlighting a pale silken canopy suspended above half of the vessel to protect the wares for sale. Sleek ebon linen sails loom overhead, casting floating shadows upon everything below their cover.
title: [The Ebon Eclipse]
29340.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shadowy velveteen fabrics soften the starkness of the bare walls and darkened flooring in the modestly sized cabin.  Flickering lights rest in the hearts of vaalin-domed glass lanterns that are placed at the outer edges of the space, imparting a warm glow to the secluded atmosphere.
title: [The Ebon Eclipse, Cabin]
29341.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An elaborate railing encloses the deck of the ship, and every inch of the vessel's timber construction has been polished to a high, flawless sheen.  Overhead, the mast balances the bundled weight of the striped buff and ultramarine sails, while a simple banner of the same colors flies over the crow's nest.  Set into the face of the upper deck, under the watch of the ship's wheel, is a sturdy round-windowed door leading down below.
title: [The Lily's Grace, Deck]
29342.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gold-set oil lamps hang between the windows, casting the area with a warm light that gilds the oak of the walls and furnishings.  Set perpendicular to the windows and nestled against the wall is a long golden oak bar laid out with a variety of drinks and edibles, while a glass-framed wall case hangs opposite.  Beneath the case is an octangular oak pedestal table, and across the way, an archway leads eastward and further into the ship.
title: [The Lily's Grace, Below Deck]
29343.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tiered oaken rack rests between a pair of cobalt-curtained windows that offer a view of the port outside, flanked to one side by a carved oak armoire and to the other by a set of golden oak hooks.  A deep blue carpeted runner extends from the archway to the west to an elaborately carved oak door across the way.
title: [The Lily's Grace, Below Deck]
29344.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Against the back wall of this modestly sized cabin is a set of bookshelves that rise to the ceiling from the wall-to-wall cabinet upon which they sit.  Several richly cushioned chairs of golden oak and blue velvet are scattered throughout the remainder of the available space, all arranged so as to offer a comfortable view out of the cobalt-curtained bay window.
title: [The Lily's Grace, Lounge]
29345.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The inside of this cheerfully appointed wagon is surprisingly spacious.  The walls are painted a pale goldenrod and artfully decorated with framed paintings, in various sizes, of bucolic landscapes.  The sweet smell of fresh-cut flowers suffuses the wagon, mingling with the robust fragrance of various aromatic teas wafting deliciously on the air.  Small tables dressed in fine linen, set with silver, and hosting elegantly carved wooden chairs, are carefully situated in the middle of the space.
title: [A Taste of Tranquility]
29349.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The plain white walls of this cozy kitchen are lined with drying racks covered in a wide variety of fragrant herbaceous leaves.  A half-completed project clutters a sturdy wooden counter near the back of the room.
title: [A Taste of Tranquility, Kitchen]
29350.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sun-bleached mat of woven rushes, curling slightly at one corner, lies in front of a whitewashed mistwood counter stacked high with various fabrics.  To one side, some baskets spattered with bright colors are arranged next to a cabinet, its doors removed and tossed nearby in a corner.  A banana plant in a terracotta pot is framed by a small window with thick panes of tinted blue glass, the leaves of the plant reaching towards the light.
title: [If The Shoe Fits, Studio]
29351.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A faint tropical scent fills the air around a glass display case.  Atop the case is a centerpiece comprised of hollow coconut shells stuffed with potpourri.  In one corner, a rope net hammock, filled with colorful silk pillows and strung from large hooks in the ceiling, hangs over a salt-stained trunk, its lid cracked and handles missing.  Some shoes and sandals, badly in need of repair, are piled next to a low dark steel workbench with a leather-covered stool positioned in front.
title: [If The Shoe Fits, Storage]
29352.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Black invar sconces are lit behind crimson-colored draped canvas near the top of the walls, giving the showroom a dim, red glow.  Displayed on the west wall are several hangers of goods and a trunk opened wide for curious customers.  On the north wall hangs a rack made of hammered steel, more than sturdy enough for its contents.  Almost hidden behind the drapes on the east wall is a curtain made of the same canvas, adorned with images of black hammers and anvils.
title: [Forging Ahead]
29356.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small forge set on the far end of the room heats the area to a toasty, but comfortable degree, the hearth glowing reddish orange from the coals within. title: [Forging Ahead, Anvil Room]
29357.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An expansive braided rug of eggplant silk stretches across the oak floor to protect it from the feet of the various display racks and tables filling the area. 29360.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A broad leather couch takes up the majority of the back wall in the alcove, allowing for plenty of seating.  A variety of sewing tools occupy a small work table pushed off to one side.
title: [Sew Nice, Alcove]
29361.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Black stripes have been painted upon the bright orange walls in a wavy pattern to elicit the appearance of a tiger's distinctive fur. title: [Nice To Be Hair, Showroom]
29369.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A platinum chandelier with variegated pearl droplets illuminates this portion of the wagon, casting light upon the metallic-sheened cheetah print walls. title: [Nice To Be Hair, Showroom]
29370.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vibrant fuchsia pillars are spaced regularly around this ostentatious salon which has been painted dark magenta with silver-lined leopard spots. Slender pedestals of carved crystal display a menagerie of bejeweled cages.
title: [Nice To Be Hair, Salon]
29371.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Golden oak walls enclose this space, brightening the decor, which is primarily composed of varying shades of dark green found in everything from the rugs underfoot to the curtains framing the windows. Above the arch leading deeper into the shop is a gold-lettered banner that reads, "Welcome to Moomph's Picklearium!"
title: [Moomph's Picklearium]
29372.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Oak sideboards set with an arrangement of glass-covered platters and trays, along with some covered wide-lipped bowls, stand along the circumference of this small area, and the scent of vinegar lingers in the air.  A green-curtained window on the back wall stands open just a bit to let in a breath of fresh air.
title: [Moomph's Picklearium]
29373.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The enclosing ebonwood walls bear a coat of matte lacquer, dulling the gloss to a subtle but refined sheen under the touch of flickering lantern light cast from behind cut glass shades. 29375.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [A Silver-Traced Ebonwood Wagon]
29376.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

29377.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Tunnel Vision]

description: A few carelessly tossed rugs cover the dirty floor, though they themselves are soiled by muddy footprints. title: [Tunnel Vision]
29379.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tent's ceiling slopes dramatically downward, ending at the point where a large spike holds the canvas firmly in the ground. title: [Tunnel Vision]
29380.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Constructed from frosted glass blocks, the interior of the wagon resembles an icy igloo. 29382.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

29383.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

29385.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

29386.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

29390.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Flyr Tara, Indoor Garden]
29396.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Centered in the room is a white marble water garden that surrounds a beautifully carved dragonfly with water spouting from its head. A small wooden table is set to the side, its surface covered with a variety of metal wires.
title: [Flyr Tara, Indoor Garden]
29397.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thick, crimson rug stretches across the rough-hewn plank floor.  Bolted into the back wall is a polished brass rod, its contents held safely off the ground. A pair of eahnor-caged lanterns frame a polished oak door carved with dragonstalks, and a lacquered oak rack serves as the centerpiece for the room.
title: [Carry On, Entry]
29400.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Inset into the westernmost wall is a small riverstone fireplace, a large pile of wooden sticks close at hand. Taking up the entirety of the southern wall is a cushioned velvet bench, and a tall silver-framed mirror is nestled into one corner.
title: [Carry On, Lounge]
29401.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pair of eahnor-caged lanterns frame the open doorway that leads back toward the main section of the cabin. A glass showcase stretches along the northern wall, and a tall oak-framed mirror is pushed into a corner.
title: [Carry On, East Wing]
29402.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sides of the covered wagon have been folded down, providing a sturdy shelf on which goods are displayed. Twin brass braziers flank a series of wooden steps leading to the interior of the schooner, providing both light and heat for patrons.

description: Stained fel boards line the floor of the wagon, covered by a deep emerald rug.  A large cottonwood cabinet stands along one wall, while a low pine shelf hangs along the middle of the opposite wall.

description: A heavy metal gate seals the elevator opening, its surface covered in thick, vivid silver-white symbols that look freshly painted despite the ship's age.  The platform beyond is polished white stone, immaculate except for a single crimson handprint smeared near the center.  Along the gate's frame, tiny glaesine studs glow faintly, brightening when the elevator aligns with a floor and dimming when it departs.

A single lantern hangs above the platform, suspended in a black iron cage and filled with ashen white light that never flickers.  A ring of burnt parchment scraps has been pressed into the floor's seams, trapped beneath a thin glaze of hardened resin.  When the elevator rises, loose ash lifts in a slow halo around your ankles, swirling like a small storm that refuses to settle.

The room is a metal square, with no discernable pathways in the bulkheads leading out.  A constant, droning whir of large machinery echoes from behind these bulkheads, but its exact source is unseen.  Pale silver-white runes are painted across the floor, all alight with a faint magical glow.  A series of lanterns hangs from the ceiling, casting crisscrossing shadows across the area.

The elevator floor is a thick metal grating, the gaps beneath revealing a hollow drop littered with dried debris and dark stains.  At the platform's edges, shallow trenches catch runoff and funnel it toward circular drains stamped with simple stick-figure pyrography.  When the elevator moves, a wet, sucking echo rises from below, as if the shaft itself breathes.

A long recess in the wall reveals a counterweight assembly: a stacked column of bone and stone bound in iron bands, rising and falling behind a grated screen.  The bones are mismatched, humanoid ribs alongside thicker animal femurs, each stained a dull, old brown as if soaked in smoke.  A single skull is fixed to the grate at eye level, its teeth painted vermillion like a warning.
